sources.title: Marker repository
sources.snapshot_note: Frozen anchor records Marker identity, output claims, model/download dependencies, and license files without treating README claims as benchmark proof.

facts.statement: GROBID, Docling, and Marker are distinct artifacts whose repository state, model assets, and licenses must be pinned separately.
accepted_qualifications: A candidate may recommend none, one, or two tools when its evidence supports the decision.

facts.statement: A documented output feature is not by itself evidence of comparable production accuracy across the three tools.
accepted_qualifications: Independent evaluations may use different corpora, versions, hardware, and metrics.

facts.statement: Offline processing feasibility must include pre-downloadable model and OCR assets rather than only absence of network calls during one conversion.

sources.title: Log Book With Computer Bug
sources.snapshot_note: Frozen anchor records the museum object identity, Harvard Mark II context, taped moth, 1947 date, and catalog limitations.

sources.title: The First Computer Bug
sources.snapshot_note: Frozen anchor preserves one influential later institutional telling for provenance comparison, not as independent proof of the event.

sources.title: Edison correspondence using bug as a technical term
sources.snapshot_note: Frozen anchor records that technical use of bug predates the Harvard moth incident; exact primary-document locator still requires verification.

facts.statement: The surviving taped-moth logbook record is associated with the Harvard Mark II and September 9, 1947, not September 9, 1945.
accepted_qualifications: A report should disclose limits of viewing a catalog surrogate rather than the physical object.

facts.statement: The logbook wording describes the moth as the first actual case of a bug being found; it does not establish the first use of bug as an engineering term.
Later institutional retellings do not independently establish that Grace Hopper personally found the moth.
accepted_qualifications: Hopper may be described as connected to the team or later retelling when supported and qualified.

sources.title: Estimated Use of Water in the United States in 2015
sources.snapshot_note: Frozen anchor records the 2015 report identity, category definitions, Mgal/day units, and distinction between withdrawal and consumption.

sources.title: 2015 water-use data tables
sources.snapshot_note: Frozen anchor records the national/state table family and revision provenance; evaluator must extract exact Arizona, Nevada, and Utah cells.

sources.title: Vintage 2015 population estimates
sources.snapshot_note: Frozen anchor records the Vintage 2015 estimate program and July 1 reference date; evaluator must verify exact state values.

facts.statement: The primary denominator is each state's July 1, 2015 resident-population estimate from Census Vintage 2015.
USGS freshwater withdrawals are not consumption and cannot by themselves establish conservation efficiency.
The requested mechanical intervals propagate one-half unit of the last displayed digit and are not sampling or model confidence intervals.
accepted_qualifications: Equivalent endpoint propagation is acceptable when formulas and unrounded inputs are exposed.

sources.title: PAN-SA-2024-0015
sources.snapshot_note: Frozen anchor records PAN-OS GlobalProtect scope, exploitation updates, mitigations, and fixed releases through cutoff.

facts.statement: All four requested CVEs were present in the CISA KEV catalog by the case cutoff, but each row has its own date added, due date, and required action.
CVE-2023-46805 and CVE-2024-21887 concern Ivanti Connect Secure or Policy Secure boundaries and must not be transferred to unrelated Ivanti products.
CVE-2024-21762 and CVE-2024-3400 require separate Fortinet and Palo Alto Networks version/remediation chains.

sources.title: Cool Pavement Pilot Program
sources.snapshot_note: Frozen anchor records Phoenix pilot design, measured surface-temperature reductions, air-temperature findings, and implementation context.

sources.title: Using Cool Pavements to Reduce Heat Islands
sources.snapshot_note: Frozen anchor records mechanism, pavement variants, potential benefits, tradeoffs, and evidence limitations.

sources.title: Phoenix cool pavement evaluation
sources.snapshot_note: Frozen anchor records measurement heights, timing, climate/site context, and pedestrian radiant-exposure concerns.

facts.statement: Lower daytime pavement surface temperature does not by itself establish lower pedestrian heat exposure or meaningful neighborhood air-temperature reduction.
Higher solar reflectance can reduce stored surface heat while increasing reflected shortwave radiation relevant to pedestrian radiant exposure and glare.
accepted_qualifications: Magnitude is site-, material-, time-, and geometry-dependent.

facts.statement: A supportable recommendation must be bounded to a monitored pilot or justified deferral rather than a promise of citywide cooling.
accepted_qualifications: Reject is also acceptable when supported by local decision criteria and evidence.

sources.title: The Open Source Definition
sources.snapshot_note: Frozen anchor records the OSD requirements, including no discrimination against persons, groups, or fields of endeavor.

sources.title: Meta's Llama license is not Open Source
sources.snapshot_note: Frozen anchor records OSI's published reasoning; evaluator must distinguish Llama versions and later AI-definition process materials.

facts.statement: The Llama 3.1 70B Instruct weights, reference code, hosted service, and third-party quantization are not automatically one licensed artifact.

The official Llama 3.1 weight license contains conditions beyond a conventional permissive software license, including an additional threshold for products or services above 700 million monthly active users.
accepted_qualifications: The report should quote the applicable text narrowly and avoid legal advice.

facts.statement: An Apache-licensed reference-code component does not establish that the model weights satisfy an open-source-only infrastructure rule.
